verdict.rationale: Docs state connectors handle incremental syncs automatically and offer connection/table-level re-sync, implying some resilience without full pipeline rebuilds, and community reports call Fivetran's syncing reliable. However there's no explicit documentation of automatic retry-on-transient-failure logic or checkpoint-based resume, and one hands-on report notes recurring 'ETL getting out of sync' requiring full re-syncs rather than seamless checkpoint resumption. Missing for 10: explicit docs on automatic retry of transient failures, explicit checkpoint/resume mechanism (vs. manual re-sync), and independent verification that syncs resume mid-stream rather than restarting.
